matter_name: VHG v. Coral Verimark Resorts LLC - Trademark Enforcement
matter_description: C&H represents Verimark Hospitality Group Inc. in enforcing its VERIMARK family of trademarks against Coral Verimark Resorts LLC, including a federal district court action for trademark infringement, unfair competition, and dilution with a motion for preliminary injunction, and a related TTAB opposition proceeding against CVR's trademark application.
matter_type: intellectual property litigation - trademark infringement enforcement (plaintiff-side)

contacts.name: Sonia M. Trevino
contacts.title: Executive Vice President and General Counsel

other_parties.name: Broadleaf Investigations Inc.
other_parties.role: VHG's private investigation firm (evidence of consumer confusion)

other_parties.name: United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, Miami Division (Hon. Adrienne M. Castellano)
USPTO Trademark Trial and Appeal Board
United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit

key_deadlines.what: Anticipated hearing on VHG's motion for preliminary injunction
CVR's publicly announced planned opening of a third resort property in Destin, Florida

status.basis: client-status-update-letter-july-2025.docx confirms active, ongoing litigation just initiated on July 22, 2025 (Verified Complaint and Motion for Preliminary Injunction filed, Case No. 1:25-cv-22847-AMC), with the engagement team 'fully staffed and committed to the vigorous prosecution of this matter' and a pending PI hearing; no closing document is present among the sources.

regulators_or_courts: United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, Miami Division
USPTO Trademark Trial and Appeal Board
United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit
governing_law: Federal law (Lanham Act, 15 U.S.C. § 1051 et seq.) and Florida state law (common law trademark infringement and Fla. Stat. § 501.204)

filing_numbers: U.S. Trademark Reg. No. 5,489,701 (VERIMARK V Design)
CVR U.S. Trademark Application Serial No. 98/432,117 (subject of opposition and cancellation claim)

significant_events.what: Coral Verimark Resorts LLC formed as a Florida LLC
CVR commenced use in commerce of 'VERIMARK RESORTS' and 'VR Verimark' marks
VHG's first cease-and-desist letter sent to CVR
C&H sent second cease-and-desist letter to CVR's counsel
TTAB Opposition No. 91/287,456 filed on VHG's behalf against CVR's trademark application
TTAB proceeding suspended by stipulation pending outcome of district court action
Verified Complaint and Motion for Preliminary Injunction filed in S.D. Fla., Case No. 1:25-cv-22847-AMC
C&H sent post-filing status update letter to client

evidence.matter_type: engagement-letter-vhg-trademark-enforcement.docx: 'The Firm will represent VHG in the prosecution of a federal trademark infringement, unfair competition, and trademark dilution action against CVR...The Firm will continue to prosecute the [TTAB] opposition proceeding'
evidence.status.value: No closing letter, invoice, or dismissal document is among the sources; the most recent document (status update letter, July 23, 2025) describes an actively prosecuted, newly-filed federal case with an upcoming PI hearing.
evidence.governing_law: Complaint and engagement letter cite the Lanham Act (federal) and Florida common law/Fla. Stat. § 501.204 (FDUTPA) as the bases for the claims asserted, rather than a contractual governing-law clause.
evidence.dates.opened: The engagement letter for this specific district-court/TTAB engagement is dated July 22, 2025 and bears 'Matter No.: 1021-00004', although it references the firm's pre-existing TTAB opposition work for VHG (filed December 3, 2024) - it is unclear whether that earlier TTAB work was tracked under this same matter number or a prior one.
